category: Usenet indexer (web only, no Newznab API found)

free_tier.stated: Reported as no registration and unlimited NZB downloads for free users, with donors getting more API access. No Newznab API answered: every /api variant tried returned the HTML home page.

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable: an NZB pointer file

retention.stated: not stated on any page reachable

egress.terms: No byte metering reported; the site serves pointers.

interface_detail: HTML site only. /api, /api/, /api.php?t=caps and /?page=api&t=caps all returned 200 with text/html and the site's own front page (6,457 bytes), so no Newznab surface is exposed at the addresses a client would try.
tooling: A wrapper has to drive the web UI; Prowlarr and NZBHydra2 cannot add it as a Newznab indexer. The absence of an API is a tooling note, not a verdict.
chaining: A manual fallback for a name when every API indexer has failed; not automatable without a scraper.

limits.value: reported unlimited NZB downloads for free users; donors get more API access

binding_note: Nothing measured could bind: no API, no account and no published counter. Naming a kind here would be invention.

identity_cost.detail: Reported 'No registration required'. Not confirmed: the home page was the only surface read.

reliability_note: A third-party listing records it as 'in heavy development with frequent downtime', so a scraper should expect intermittent failure.
confidence_note: The absence of a Newznab endpoint was measured across four candidate paths today; the free, unlimited, no-registration claim and the reliability note are third-party.

evidence.proved: returned 200 with text/html and the site front page, 6,457 bytes, not a caps document
third-party: 'No registration required. Unlimited NZB downloads for free users. Donors get more API access.' and 'in heavy development with frequent downtime'

notes: Four API paths returning the home page is the shape of a single-page app with a catch-all route, not of a retired API. A client that needs automation should look for an API on a subdomain before concluding there is none.
